prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1072; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain and swelling. Over three office visits, the patient was evaluated and managed conservatively. Causation of the knee complaints relative to this collision remains unclear at this time, and further correlation with mechanism and imaging history is recommended. Examination revealed some findings consistent with a soft tissue or ligamentous injury, including localized tenderness and limited flexion, while other orthopedic tests and neurovascular checks were within normal limits. No prior injury to the same knee is known to this provider. Recovery has taken somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of presentation, and ongoing physical therapy and activity modification have been recommended. Billing records show two similar charges posted on the same service day, which are currently being reviewed for accuracy. Follow-up will be scheduled to reassess symptoms and functional progress.
